name: bld3_rank_tripotent_defect
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) : Matrix.rank (A * A + A) + Matrix.rank (A * A - A) = Matrix.rank A + Matrix.rank (A * A * A - A)
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), Matrix.rank (A * A + A) + Matrix.rank (A * A - A) = Matrix.rank A + Matrix.rank (A * A * A - A)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld_frobenius_rank_inequality and Mathlib2.bld2_tripotent_rank_split: generalises the tripotent rank split (the case A^3 = A); ≤ is Frobenius for the triple (A + 1, A, A - 1); ≥ by block elimination on diag(A^2 + A, A^2 - A) using 2A = (A^2 + A) - (A^2 - A) and invertibility of 2.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), (A * A + A).rank + (A * A - A).rank = A.rank + (A * A * A - A).rank
